title: Business Office Counter Schedule: Withdrawals from Resident Trust Fund Accounts
content:
The business office pays money out of the Resident Trust Fund Accounts on the following terms. The payment terms are the same in every tier; who signs depends on the tier.

## Who signs a withdrawal

| Tier | Person whose signed request authorizes a withdrawal | Guardian's written authorization needed for every withdrawal or transfer |
|---|---|---|
| Resident Funds Account, Medicaid Self-Directed | the resident, or an agent under the resident's power of attorney | No |
| Resident Funds Account, Medicaid Representative Payee | the center as representative payee, honoring the resident's request | No |
| Resident Funds Account, Medicaid Guardianship | the court-appointed guardian of the estate | Yes |
| Resident Funds Account, Non-Medicaid Self-Directed | the resident, or an agent under the resident's power of attorney | No |
| Resident Funds Account, Non-Medicaid Representative Payee | the center as representative payee, honoring the resident's request | No |
| Resident Funds Account, Non-Medicaid Guardianship | the court-appointed guardian of the estate | Yes |

## How the money is paid (all tiers)

| Term | Value |
|---|---|
| Largest cash withdrawal from the petty cash fund in one transaction | $100.00 |
| Petty cash hours | weekdays, 9:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. |
| Larger amounts | paid by check within 3 business days |
| Receipt | the person receiving cash signs a receipt |
| Withdrawal or transfer above the available balance | not allowed |
| Power of attorney after the resident's death | authorizes nothing |

## Points of judgement

- A request for $100.00 in cash on a weekday at 10:00 a.m. can be met from petty cash; a request for $100.01 is paid by check.
- In the guardianship tiers every withdrawal and every transfer rests on the guardian's written authorization.
